You: How to add a friend in discord?:
To add a friend on Discord, follow these steps:

1. Open the Discord app and navigate to the server where you want to add your friend.
2. Click on the "Friends" tab at the top of the screen.
3. Click on the "Add Friend" button.
4. Enter your friend's username or email address in the search bar.
5. Select your friend from the list of results.
6. Click on the "Add Friend" button to send a friend request.

Source: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002565151-How-do-I-add-friends-on-Discord-

Note: If you are having trouble adding a friend, make sure that both you and your friend have Discord installed and that you are connected to the same server.
